newsitem.title: USA: Fed likely to add reserves via small RP operation.
newsitem.headline: Fed likely to add reserves via small RP operation.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday.
Analysts said if the Fed added reserves, it would likely be through a small system repurchase operation, since the Treasury's balances at the Fed have been low.
High Treasury balances at the Fed drain reserves from the banking system. Low balances do the opposite.
Analysts said with Fed funds trading at a relatively soft 5-7/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target for the rate, the Fed might even refrain from open market operations.
